bug_info.bug_desc: During an update operation, the TLB replaces an entry even when a lookup hit occurs in the same cycle. The spec states that if a lookup hit occurs during the same cycle as an update, the update shall be ignored because the existing hit entry is already correct. The buggy code only checks update_i.valid and replace_en[i], missing the !lu_hit_o condition, causing an unnecessary and incorrect replacement of a valid matching entry.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add the condition '&& !lu_hit_o' to the update enable logic so that an update only proceeds when no lookup hit is detected in the same cycle. The fix should be applied in the update_flush always_comb block where the replacement condition is evaluated.
